en.topic_title: 78% of low-income elderly Hongkongers have suffered heat-related distress – Greenpeace
en.topic_summary:
Close to 80 per cent of low-income elderly residents in Hong Kong report suffering physical or mental distress related to extreme heat, a Greenpeace survey has found, highlighting the demographic’s vulnerability to rising temperatures.



Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
